SELECT FIN.FINPROD_ID id, FIN.FINPROD_MARKET_ID col, nvl(FIN.FINPROD_ABBR, FIN.FINPROD_NAME) text, FIN_TYPE.TYPE_12 object FROM FIN_PRODUCT FIN LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FIN_TYPE ON FIN.FINPROD_ID = FIN_TYPE.FINPROD_ID where 1=1
AND ( FIN_TYPE.TYPE_1 = '033' /**优先股**/ OR ( FIN.IS_SUS = 'Y' AND FIN.IS_RIGHT = 'N' /** 不含权永续债 **/ ) )
AND (FIN.FINPROD_ID like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FIN.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FIN.FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{search,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') )
AND (FIN.FINPROD_ID like concat(concat('%', #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR FINPROD_NAME like concat(concat('%', #{initValue,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') )
